def: The program that starts an experiment, enforces its deadline, reads its score and decides keep, discard or crash.
A program whose job is to start another program, watch it, limit it and report on it.
The rule that every value has exactly one owner and is freed when the owner goes out of scope.
Lending a reference to a value for a while without giving up ownership of it.
A type that is either Some value or None, so that the absence of a value is visible in the type.
A type that is either Ok with a value or Err with an error, so that failure is visible in the type.
A type with a fixed list of variants, and an expression that must handle every variant.
A process that has ended but whose exit status has not yet been collected by its parent.
Waiting for a child process by repeatedly checking whether it has exited until a time limit passes.
